title: Recruitment application-form builder
summary: Staff can now add their own questions to each recruitment role's application form. Applicants answer them when they apply, and staff see the answers with the application.
changes: Add an Application questions panel to each recruitment role, where staff add, reorder and remove questions.
Questions can be short or long answers, optional or required, with help text.
The role's application form shows the questions and checks required answers.
Answers are saved with the application and shown to staff and the applicant.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a new table and a nullable column for an optional form builder; existing roles and applications are unchanged.
validation: New feature test for adding, ordering and removing questions, required answers, saved answers and refused access.
Recruitment, migration, rollback, translation and audit tests.
Full PHPUnit suite and the MySQL contract job in CI.
known_limitations: Questions are text answers only. Answers keep the question wording from the time of applying.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new table and column can stay; earlier releases ignore them, and saved answers are not shown until this release returns.
provenance: Milestone v0.47.4 Beta, issue #469 under epic #463, pull request #597.
